s.note: the nightclub where toons wait tables
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo. Top buttered rye squares with 100g smoked salmon. Glaze 16 cocktail franks in a pan with 2 tbsp brown sugar and a splash of water. Serve on silver trays.
Toss 2 bunches baby carrots with 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cumin, thyme and oil. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until caramelised. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt for the dip.

m.note: lunch at his desk in the office
m.how: Steam 400g pastrami for 10 minutes until glossy. Pile onto 8 slices rye with mustard and 4 slices Swiss cheese. Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle on the side.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 250g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Layer with cream cheese frosting and pour a glossy red icing over the top.

d.n: Eddie's ginger beer on the rocks
d.note: the bottle in Eddie's desk drawer, kept well away from Roger
d.how: Put one large ice block in each of 4 heavy tumblers. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 2 drops vanilla extract. Top each with 200ml cold ginger beer, poured slowly so it keeps its fizz. Stir once and add a lime wheel. Serve at the desk, with a fedora if you have one.
